rules.statement: The burden rests on the unsuccessful claimant to prove that at the date of seizure he had the right which he claims.
rules.supporting_quote: "The burden rests on him to prove that he had that right at the date of seizure (vide Silva v. Nona Hamine 1[(1906) 10 N. L. R. 44.] and Abubackar v. Tikiri Banda 2[(1926) 29 N. L. R. 132])."
